labelerRoster.attestation: identity + non-participation + no-prior-exposure attestations for L1/L2/(T if invoked) recorded BEFORE any sealed read; absent attestation ⇒ labels VOID

calibration.set: 20-row disjoint set: 12 known-type rows drawn from v4 dev gold in NON-FLOORED classes (pool: 21 classes / 176 rows — excludes all 10 floored classes under investigation) + 4 no-fit + 4 insufficient-evidence v4 rows (pools 222/64); Main draws + records SKUs before calibration; labelers never see sealed rows before passing
calibration.bar: ≥18/20 agreement with v4 gold on (productType kind+typeId, field states) AND zero forced fits (any forced fit = fail regardless of score); L1 and L2 calibrate SEPARATELY, both must pass; results published with the labels
calibration.neverSealed: calibration touches ZERO sealed rows; a labeler who fails may re-attempt once on a fresh 20-row draw, then is replaced

labelingRules.citationBinding: every known field value cites sealed excerpt(s) (source locator + excerpt reference); every no-fit/insufficient verdict cites its reason; uncited labels INVALID and excluded
labelingRules.noPriors: no per-row priors from dev attrition rates; each row judged on its own excerpts; forced fits disqualify the labeler and void their labels
labelingRules.peerRederivation: FULL-SET (n=37 small): L2 independently re-derives all 37; per-row agreement published; disagreements adjudicated by T with citations published; agreement statistics per class in the G5 record
labelingRules.sealedHandling: labeling reads sealed payloads for the first time; access logging on; labeled rows NEVER merge into dev banks, NEVER inform capture/policy/threshold changes
labelingRules.scope: 37 eligible families ONLY; Batch1/2 + ghosts never labeled, never read

foreknownContext: 37 rows cannot support any 20-row class floor under disposition B (max per-class support ≤37 even if unanimous, and floored set needs 10×20=200); this run formally establishes per-class support + outcome rates for the G5 record — outcome pre-registered as informative, not a failure of execution
halts: any allowlist breach, attestation gap, calibration failure ×2, forced fit, dev-merge attempt, or ghost/Batch1-2 read ⇒ HALT + report to reviewer; Main commissions labelers AFTER this authorization
captureAuthorization: AUTHORIZATION ONLY — no labeling executed by this review. Labels + agreement stats need reviewer acceptance at G5 before any floor claim is cited. No capture, no publication beyond the G5 record.
